verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a task/workflow orchestration engine for background jobs and AI agents built by developers — it exposes workflows as tools for external agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK) but does not itself embed a built-in AI assistant persona for users to delegate tasks to. This is a category mismatch: Hatchet is agent-orchestration infrastructure, not a user-facing product with a built-in assistant.
